YTD Methodology & Visual Checkbox UI

Tracks the Cumulative Return on Investment (ROI) of major Layer-1 and DeFi assets since January 1st of each respective year.

How to use this Sandbox:

  • Multi-Dimensional Checkboxes: Check any combination of Assets and Years to instantly draw them on the chart.
  • Macro Grouping: The Year filter is logically separated into Bull, Bear, and Transition years.
